name: paths
description: Well-known host directories, absolute: { home, temp, appData, cache } — appData is %APPDATA% / ~/Library/Application Support / $XDG_CONFIG_HOME (default ~/.config); cache is %LOCALAPPDATA% / ~/Library/Caches / $XDG_CACHE_HOME (default ~/.cache). An empty string means the host could not resolve that one. Additive action: an older host answers NOT_IMPLEMENTED.
